name: Royal Trip Holidays
description: Hanoi: Hanoi, a city of lakes, shaded boulevards and public parks, is the capital of Vietnam. It is a very attractive city with French-style architecture. Take part in the Water Puppet show. Halong Bay: Overnight cruise in a traditional Junk boat, discover caves & fishing villages, explore the lagoon.

name: Top Things To Do For Backpackers
description: Sun-kissed beaches, top places to party, motorbike routes begging to be discovered, and locals so friendly you’ll think you’re family. To help, we’ve compiled this treasure map like list to help you reveal the top things to do for backpackers in Vietnam.

name: The Most Unforgettable Vietnam
description: Vietnam is a land full of staggering beauty, embracing the urban metropolis cultures in all strength, encompassing a variety of diverse cultures and ethnicity. The beautiful country boats of multiple vistas and breathtaking cityscapes that will have you marvelling at the exhilarating views.

name: Overnight Sapa Tour from Hanoi
description: This action-packed overnight trip to Sapa is the easy way to visit the beautiful northern region from Hanoi. Take an overnight bus, arrive in Sapa in good time to visit Cat Cat, an ethnic minority village. The next day, hike to more beautiful villages, including Lao Chai and Ta Van, and through the dramatic rice terraces. Hike without the risk of getting lost with a local guide.

name: The Best Time To Visit Tam Coc
description: Along with the famous Halong Bay, Ninh Binh province is one of the must-see destinations in Vietnam with beautiful landscapes and tranquil atmosphere.
